verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents a single-command deep crawl (`crwl <url> --deep-crawl bfs --max-pages N`) that follows a site's links and returns content from many pages. It also supports parallel crawling, fast URL discovery via prefetch, and crash recovery for long-running deep crawls via resume_state. missing for 10: in-depth docs on Python deep-crawl strategies and whole-site scope controls (limits, domain filters, sitemap use), and independent or hands-on corroboration of crawling an entire site end to end.
